title: Limit Rent for an Existing-Customer Increase on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The increase limit on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the contracted monthly rent times one plus the class's largest single increase, rounded down to the cent. The reduction notice's new rent is the lesser of the noticed new rent and the limit rent.

## Definitions

- **Noticed increase** — the agreement's latest existing-customer rate increase notice, by notice date; its **noticed new rent** is the new rent that notice carries.
- **Limit percentage** — the class's largest single increase.
- **Allowed increase** — the limit percentage applied once to the contracted monthly rent, rounded down to the cent.
- **Limit rent** — the contracted monthly rent plus the allowed increase.
- **New rent of the reduction notice** — the lesser of the noticed new rent and the limit rent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical class with a 12% largest single increase)

| Contracted rent | Allowed increase | Limit rent | Noticed new rent | Reduction notice new rent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $150.00 | $18.00 | $168.00 | $175.00 | $168.00 |
| $133.33 | $15.99 (from $15.9996, rounded down) | $149.32 | $149.00 | none; the increase is at or below the limit |
| $200.00 | $24.00 | $224.00 | $224.00 | none; the increase equals the limit |

Rounding down means the fraction of a cent is dropped, never carried up.
